Hi, I'm Breno and I'm a software engineer from Brazil.

This site is being served from the homelab with Proxmox VE(Virtual Environment), Kubernetes(k3s) provisioned with OpenTofu(Terraform) and ArgoCD for Gitops. What follows is the whole of it — the design, and then a reading taken from the running cluster.

Reach out: breno@buzaga.com.br

How this is built

The shape of the project. It changes when a decision changes, not when a pod restarts — the part that moves is in the snapshot below. 

        ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │  Claude Code  ──  OpenSpec (spec-driven)  │
        │  learning loop  ·  operator console       │
        └─────────────────────┬─────────────────────┘
                              │  plans, then provisions
                              ▼
        ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
        │  OpenTofu  ─────────▶  Proxmox VE         │
        └─────────────────────┬─────────────────────┘
                              │  one VM, bootstrapped by cloud-init
                              ▼
        ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐         ┌──────────┐
        │  k3s                                      │  pull   │          │
        │                                           │◀────────│  GitHub  │
        │     ArgoCD  ──reconciles──▶  nginx        │         │          │
        └─────────────────────┬─────────────────────┘         └──────────┘
                              │  Cloudflare tunnel
                              ▼

Cluster snapshot

Read from the cluster by a command, then committed. No part of this section was written by hand.

  • Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS · containerd 2.3.2-k3s2

How it got here

None of it was deployed by hand. A program inside the cluster watches a Git repository and continuously makes the cluster match it, so the repository is the record of what is running rather than a description of what someone intended.

  • site · Synced · Healthy
  • reconciled from https://github.com/salgadobreno/homelab-infra at k8s/site
